purpose: Hand-authored (Claude, not Gemini) multi-label requirements for the 'payments_cards' domain, to teach the BERT classifier category semantics outside BFSI vocabulary. Every item is UNVERIFIED and needs a human label pass before it enters permanent training data.
instructions_for_reviewers: Confirm each 'categories' list against your project's 13-category definitions; add/remove labels.
Watch for over-labelling with 'Functional' -- keep it only where the system performs a concrete action.
'Regulatory' = a legal/standard mandate; 'Security' = protection mechanism. Don't conflate.
Single-label items are fine. Flip 'verified' to true only after a human check.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to link a debit or credit card to their wallet after a successful one-time-password verification.
The system shall decline a card transaction when the merchant category code is blocked for the cardholder's card product.
The system shall authorise or decline a card payment within two seconds of receiving the request from the merchant terminal.
The system shall tokenise every stored card number so that the primary account number is never retained in application databases.
The system shall comply with PCI-DSS requirements for the storage, processing, and transmission of cardholder data.
The payment authorisation service shall maintain 99.99 percent availability measured on a rolling thirty-day basis.
The system shall fail over to a secondary processing site within sixty seconds of a primary outage without dropping in-flight authorisations.
The system shall settle merchant funds to the merchant's bank account within one business day of transaction capture, net of applicable fees.
The system shall exchange authorisation, clearing, and settlement messages with the card networks in ISO 8583 format.
The system shall calculate and deduct the merchant discount rate and applicable taxes from each settlement batch.
The system shall let a merchant issue a full or partial refund against an original transaction within one hundred eighty days of the sale.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of every authorisation, capture, refund, and chargeback with immutable timestamps.
The system shall block a card after five consecutive declined authorisation attempts within ten minutes to stop card-testing attacks.
The system shall support 3-D Secure authentication for online card transactions where the issuer requires it.
The system shall provide the merchant a self-service dashboard showing settled amounts, fees, refunds, and chargebacks by day.
The system shall notify the merchant within five minutes of a chargeback being raised against one of their transactions.
The system shall process at least three thousand authorisation requests per second at peak with 99th-percentile latency under five hundred milliseconds.
The system shall reconcile network settlement files against internal transaction records daily and escalate unmatched entries to operations.
The system shall retain transaction records for a minimum of seven years to meet regulatory and dispute-resolution requirements.
The system shall allow a customer to raise a dispute for an unrecognised transaction directly from the transaction history screen.
The system shall obtain the customer's consent before enrolling their card for recurring merchant billing.
The system shall restrict access to full card numbers to authorised fraud-investigation staff and log every such access.
The system shall let the risk team configure velocity rules, such as a maximum amount per card per day, without a deployment.
The system shall display transaction amounts and fees in the customer's local currency and language.
The system shall alert the on-call team when the authorisation approval rate drops more than ten percentage points below the trailing twenty-four-hour average.
The system shall recover to an alternate region within a recovery time objective of thirty minutes and a recovery point objective of one minute for captured transactions.
The system shall reject any settlement instruction that would move funds to an account not previously verified for the merchant.
The system shall generate a monthly interchange and scheme-fee report for the finance team to validate network invoices.
The system shall apply software updates through rolling deployments so that authorisation processing is not interrupted during maintenance.
The system shall notify a customer in real time by push notification and SMS whenever their card is charged.
